about: Indicative plot massings for the JindalX options (scripts/world/plot_massing.py). Floor plate and storeys from the client's workbook (JindalX options.xlsx); position from the indicative pins in jindalx/build-data.cjs; orientation squared to the nearest Overture road. Not surveyed: confirm the plot with the landlord, then replace the outline.

magnus-towers.basis: Magnus Greens (plot C-2, Sector 67): traced from Google z20 satellite 2026 and Street View 2025-26 (review only, nothing copied): a 131 x 28 m block, G+5 per the workbook, 25 m. Footprint +-4 m; the boundary-wall plot is not established (part of a larger walled campus), so the plot is the block grown by 10.5 m, which matches the wall seen at about y=-392. Gate: a probable construction gate on the east road (low confidence), snapped to the plot's east wall. No gate in the road-front wall.

a104.basis: A-104 (identity inferred, LOW confidence): the vacant charcoal-ACP and blue-glass block ~140 m west of the old pin, outline traced from Google z20 satellite 2026 (+-5 m), regularised to a rectangle (roof plate ~1,950 m2 vs the workbook's 2,323 m2). Steel sliding gate and guard hut on the narrow west lane (front faces that lane); a solid compound wall to the wide east road. Landlord must supply the plot plan.

a14-18-19.basis: A-14 only (the front plot, 452 m2: 12.6 m frontage x 36 m on Amaltash Marg), NOT the A-14/18/19 amalgam: the workbook's 18,000 sq ft a floor cannot stand on it, and A-18/19 are probably rear plots. 'plot' is the traced plot; 'poly' (what the explorer collides with) is the building inside it: 4 m forecourt in front, 0.6 m at the sides, 3 m behind. G+4 on an open stilt floor, no set-back upper block (the 2026 imagery shows none). One entrance gate on the frontage.

d1.basis: D-1: outline traced from Street View and Google z21 roof edges (+-4 m, ~1,600 m2), regularised to a rectangle. The NW end (with the round glazed corner tower and the green glass bay) is the front; gates at the proposal's two points (SW frontage gate, NW forecourt gate; low-medium). B+G+2 per the workbook (the imagery shows 3 to 4 levels).
